domains.Account: The account area a student uses on the public website.
domains.Gdpr: Cookie and privacy consent captured in the browser.
domains.Legal: Legal document publishing and user consent acceptance.
domains.Media: Video and file storage, transcoding and secure playback.
domains.Payments: Student and academy payments: checkout, gateway callbacks, refunds.
domains.RequestStorm: Client-side circuit breaker: one API route called far above human speed.
domains.SitePreview: Preview rendering of an academy site template.

events.RequestStorm.Tripped: A single route exceeded the per-window hit limit in the student's browser; protected routes force a sign-out and storage wipe.
